sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer moves a non-Copy value into a function, and the compiler rejects any later use of the moved binding.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given cannot remain available to the giver.

sketches.mechanism: Optional values are not implicitly treated as their contained type, so using nil as an Int is a type error until it is unwrapped.
sketches.resonance: Absence may occupy the place of an answer, but it cannot be counted as one.

sketches.mechanism: Selective receive only continues when a message matches the given pattern; all other messages leave the process waiting.
sketches.resonance: A life can fill with arrivals and still be suspended by the one form it is waiting for.
